name: [REDACTED]
source:
Just you, and [REDACTED]. No one else. He's just gonna ask you a couple questions is all.

This is a game where you have a "therapy session" with [REDACTED]. No judgement at all, and nothing will be recorded. You can play as many times as you feel like you need.

[From [url=https://itsyaboi328.itch.io/redacted]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
只有你和[REDACTED]。没有其他人。他只会问你几个问题而已。

在这款游戏中，你可以与[REDACTED]进行“治疗”。根本没有任何判断，也不会记录任何内容。你可以根据需要多次玩。
